headline: Wilson Holdings discloses substantial acquisition in TruCap Finance under SEBI takeover norms
sum: Wilson Holdings Private Limited has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) relating to a substantial acquisition of shares in TruCap Finance Limited, disclosed to NSE on 7 July 2026.
detail: The filing constitutes a formal regulatory disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) requires that once a substantial acquisition is completed, the acquirer must furnish a copy of the disclosure to the stock exchange. The NSE archives reference indicates this was submitted to and acknowledged by NSE. Specific transaction value, share percentage acquired, consideration structure, and conditions precedent are not disclosed in the article text and would require review of the full PDF filing.
